title: Add portable susi-tools speed command and retire speed-report.ps1
goal: Add portable Rust command susi-tools speed [--repo <path>] [--cold] [--json], tests against a tiny throwaway workspace, remove scripts/speed-report.ps1, and update README.md and ECOSYSTEM.md.

reuse.searched: scripts/speed-report.ps1 (Windows PowerShell script being replaced), src/git.rs, src/git_program.rs, src/json.rs, src/time.rs in susi-tools, and Rust stdlib plus cargo/git CLIs
reuse.reason: Susi Tools takes zero external crate dependencies and needs a portable Rust command replacing the PowerShell script, reusing existing git_program, json and time modules.
